articles.title: Global financial watchdog calls for cross-border information sharing, planning for stablecoin crisis
articles.snippet: Coins jointly issued by multiple companies can trap reserves in one jurisdiction while redemption demands hit another, complicating cross-border crisis response.

articles.title: Visa survey says nearly half of APAC consumers open to using stablecoins by 2031
articles.snippet: Visa’s survey of 14,250 people found interest in stablecoin payments is growing, though only 6% of respondents correctly understood how they work.

articles.title: US accounting overhaul could make stablecoins more attractive to corporations: Tempo
articles.snippet: A Tempo report examines how proposed US accounting rules could change corporate stablecoin holdings, with direct redemption rights determining which tokens qualify as cash.

articles.title: Standard Chartered adds Ripple USD custody, eyes LMAX collateral deal
articles.snippet: Standard Chartered has launched custody for Ripple’s RLUSD stablecoin on the XRP Ledger and plans to let institutions use the tokens as trading collateral.

articles.title: Global watchdog flags stablecoin risks, AI threats ahead of G20
articles.snippet: The Financial Stability Board flagged cross-border stablecoin risks and AI-related cybersecurity threats while urging G20 policymakers to support stronger safeguards.
